dog.description_text:
My foster writes:
Meet this adorable little lady! She's a playful girl with a big personality and an even bigger appetite! While she's still learning to trust humans and isn't quite ready for pets, she's full of curiosity and loves playing with her sister.
She has the sweetest little meow and isn't afraid to use it when it's time for dinner (she takes her meals very seriously). She's also a dedicated bathroom supervisor and will happily keep you company from a safe distance.
She's looking for a patient, loving home where she can continue to build her confidence at her own pace. She may not be a cuddle bug just yet, but her quirky personality and adorable little habits make her impossible not to love.
dog.name: Midnight Blues
